prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption hint, adoption new flow, choose path hint, and home notifications, as each has only 1 test.
Path layout changes (choose_path, layout) can be helpful, yielding 1 winning test across 4 tests.
Finish new screen changes (finish, new_screen) can be helpful, producing 1 winning test across 4 tests (though 1 test performed significantly worse).
Sign-in hint changes (sign_in, hint) can be helpful, producing 1 winning test across 4 tests.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) and adoption redesign changes (adoption, redesign) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, but underpredicted winning tests in Round 2 (path layout) and Round 3 (finish new screen).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_flow: -4.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -0.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +1.4% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.5% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- home, notification: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.2% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.9% after noise correction, 4 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 69.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.3%

"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Split Overview Layout: Redesign the adoption certificate step into a split layout presenting pet traits alongside official adoption details. (why: Adoption is the biggest funnel bottleneck with only 60.9% conversion, showing users stall while reviewing adoption details.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Account Sign-In Order: Move sign-in to take place right before final home setup instead of before selecting and customizing a pet. (why: Sign-in currently happens before pet selection; moving it later lets users form an emotional bond with their pet first.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick Start Screen: Add a dedicated summary screen before finish detailing desktop tray shortcuts and pet interaction commands. (why: Support receives multiple tickets (3 emails) from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Style Selection Flow: Insert a style picker screen during custom pet adoption so users can select rendering styles before generation. (why: Support receives 3 emails about custom pet rendering failures or visual misconfiguration, hurting adoption conversion (60.9%).)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Renderer Launch Time Info: Enable time estimates and explicit progress indicators on the waiting screen during desktop pet loading. (why: Home waiting stage has a long mean duration of 2336s (median 201s), causing user drop-off due to uncertain wait times.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Scroll Showcase Layout: Switch the introductory story screen layout to story_scroll to highlight key pet behaviors upfront. (why: Path selection has a high mean time of 514s, indicating users take a long time to understand app capabilities before deciding.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Pet Profile Sync Notice: Display a explicit reassurance hint on sign-in clarifying that logging in preserves existing pet data. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in, creating friction during sign-in.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Docking Ready Notification: Enable desktop readiness notifications on home_intro to confirm when the pet successfully launches into the system tray. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets failing to appear on the desktop or launch cleanly upon completing onboarding.)
8: [adoption, incentive] Friend Selection Badge Highlight: Add highlight badges to pet options on pick_friend screen to guide pet selection. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9%, needing stronger visual incentives.)
